_what: THE OFFER — one file, every brief's beat 7 reads from it. Change it here, push, and every brief on the portal shows the new offer within a minute. Nothing else to edit.
_why: Founder, 23 Sep 2026: 'traditionally if I want to change the offer I need to go into every single HTML and apply the changes. Rather, I want the HTMLs wired up to something central. And then when I want to change something, I just change that central thing.'
_scope: BEAT 7 ONLY (his call). Other beats keep their own wording.
_how_to_change_it: 2. git add offer.json && git commit -m 'offer: <what changed>' && git push
3. GitHub Pages rebuilds in a minute. Every brief is current - no brief files touched.
lines: They’re Baybella’s, and the link’s on this video.
Say if you gave up years ago, you’ve been going without for no reason.
action: hold the kit up to camera
